Why Onyx

At Onyx, we’re working on one of the hardest and most important challenges of our time: helping organizations safely control AI systems that are gaining more autonomy and authority every day. The stakes are high, and the problems are complex, but that’s exactly why we’re here. We take responsibility for the outcomes we create, tackle difficult problems head-on, and focus on delivering real results.

We go beyond expectations to create moments that surprise and delight our customers, partners, and teammates. Collaboration isn’t just encouraged, it’s how we operate. When people take ownership, help others do their best work, and succeed collectively, we build something far greater than any one person could on their own. Together, we'll help the world control the most sophisticated forms of AI.
